contract.writer: POSIX flock held across exact whole-file CAS, append, fsync and exact readback
contract.integration: Existing evaluation ADMIT/SLOT/CLOSE and RESERVE/COMMIT APIs already accept a DurableAppendWriter; this writer can be supplied without changing scientific event semantics.
contract.cross_file_atomicity: not claimed or required; main-journal and reservation-ledger partial orders remain reconciled by the existing fail-closed recovery contracts

scope_limitations: This establishes cooperative single-host/process serialization only on filesystems where POSIX flock has reliable exclusion semantics.
It is not a distributed lease/fencing protocol for NFS, object stores, multi-host writers, or callers that bypass the writer.

A process that dies after a partial write can leave a torn tail; subsequent CAS fails rather than appending through the damage, and recovery must truncate/quarantine to the last validated prefix before retry.
No scientific claim extends beyond writer serialization and exact durable-prefix preservation.
